account.avatarHint: Your avatar comes from Gravatar; change it at gravatar.com.
account.notificationsHint: We'll email you about the following.
account.remindExpire: Remind me before my plan expires
account.remindTraffic: Remind me when my traffic is running out

password.title: Change password
password.hint: Every device is signed out afterwards; sign in again with the new password.
password.newHint: At least {min} characters. A password manager can generate one.
password.same: The new password must differ from the current one
password.changed: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication (authenticator app)
totp.hint: Besides your password, sign-in asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app.
totp.step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app.
totp.appsHint: For example 1Password, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
totp.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
totp.openApp: Open in an authenticator on this device
totp.codeOrBackup: Enter a 6-digit code or one of your backup codes.
totp.codeOrBackupInvalid: Enter a 6-digit code or a backup code (xxxxx-xxxxx)
totp.disableHint: Sign-in will only need your password, and all backup codes stop working.

backup.title: Save your backup codes
backup.once: These codes are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe.
backup.about: Each backup code works once and lets you sign in without your authenticator.
backup.low: You're running low on backup codes. Generate new ones.
backup.regenerateHint: Your old backup codes stop working. Confirm with a code from your authenticator.
backup.fileHint: Each code works once. Keep them private.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. Passkeys can live in iCloud Keychain, 1Password, Bitwarden and other password managers and sync across devices.
passkeys.addHint: Name it so you can recognise it later, then follow your browser's or password manager's prompt.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.cancelled: Passkey creation was cancelled. You can try again any time.
passkeys.duplicate: This device or password manager already has a passkey for your account.
passkeys.verifyFailed: The passkey couldn't be verified or the request timed out. Try again.
passkeys.security: This passkey doesn't match this address. Open the site on its official domain.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Use a current Safari, Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
passkeys.notConfigured: Passkeys aren't enabled on this site: an administrator must set the site URL to a domain name (WebAuthn doesn't work with IP addresses).
passkeys.failed: Couldn't create the passkey. Try again.
passkeys.removeHint: You won't be able to sign in with it any more. Confirm with your current password.
passkeys.removed: Passkey removed. Remove it from the device or password manager too.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.conflict: Something changed in the meantime. The page was refreshed; try again.
errors.codeWrong: That code or backup code is incorrect

mfaRequired.toast: The admin area requires two-factor authentication or a passkey. Set one up first.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.hint: Bind Telegram to get expiry, traffic and subscription alerts there.
telegram.unbindHint: You will no longer get alerts on Telegram. You can bind again at any time.
telegram.step1: Use the button below, or scan the QR code with your phone, to open {bot} in Telegram.
telegram.step2: Tap Start and the bot finishes binding automatically.
telegram.manual: Or send this to {bot} in Telegram:
telegram.codeError: Could not get a binding code.
telegram.expires: The code is valid for 10 minutes; getting a new one revokes the old one.
telegram.disabled: The administrator has not enabled Telegram yet.
telegram.unavailable: Telegram cannot be reached right now. Try "Get a new code" again in a moment.
